author: MK
text: Phase 1 in progress. Decisions locked: Q-1.2 (task classes = enumerated yaml keys), Q-1.5/P0 (option A: escalate.go calls routing for next rung; local ladder + dup fable check deleted), Q-2.2 (type all 3 cost models in v1). First implementation landed: extracted the byte-identical fable-window check (routing.fableWindowOpen == dispatch.fableEscalationOpen) into internal/capability.FrontierWindowOpen with tests; de-risks the Phase 2 escalation refactor. 17 Phase-1 design questions remain (need a.r. decisions). Commit ba3fa37.

author: MK
text: DoD clause 1 now has executable, passing enforcement. Landed internal/routing/registry.go (deployment-keyed capability registry: provenance-tagged vectors, typed 3-way cost, trust_zone, version_stability, staleness downgrade) + constraint.go (flat fail-closed trust-zone constraints) + seed fixture (real deployments). TestDoD_ClientConfidentialRoutesLocalOnly PASSES: client-confidential routes only to zklw-local, vendor-cloud APIs blocked with typed error. Vet+race clean. Commit 31d3687. This is the first half of the DoD's first clause (routing side); the 'blocks otherwise' behavior is proven at the mechanism layer. Still ahead: wire into ic route CLI (Phase 3), evidence observability (Phase 5), Hermes end-to-end (Phase 7).

author: MK
text: Phase 3 first cut landed: 'ic route decide' subcommand (cmd/ic/route.go). Registry-based, constraint-enforcing, with spec exit codes 0/1/3/4. DoD clause 1 is now proven END-TO-END at the command boundary (not just unit test): ran the built binary across all 4 codes — client-confidential returns only zklw-local (exit 0); client-confidential with no local deployment fails closed (exit 4, the 'blocks otherwise' clause); malformed input exits 3. Regression-guarded by TestRouteDecideExitCodes (5 cases pass). Commit a6b3f8c. DoD clause 1 (client-confidential routes+blocks) is DONE at mechanism+CLI. Remaining for full DoD: escalation observable (needs Phase 2 option-A refactor), evidence events (Phase 5), and the actual Hermes-on-zklw end-to-end run (Phase 7).

author: MK
text: P0 FIXED (Phase 2, option A). escalate.go's nextRungModel now calls routing.NextRung instead of walking a hardcoded ['sonnet','opus','fable'] ladder. Capability ordering lives in ONE place (internal/routing/escalation.go); the duplicated frontier-window check is gone. 'Roles not model names' is now true at the retry surface, not just ic route. Behavior-preserving: existing TestNextRungModelTwoStrikes (6 cases) passes unchanged + new TestNextRung authority test. Registry-vector ranking is now a drop-in to NextRung's body once §2 lands. Vet+race clean across routing/dispatch/cmd-ic. Commit 570ceb7.

author: MK
text: Both 'observable in evidence' halves of DoD clause 2 now have working, tested emission (Phase 5 emission side): DecisionStore.RecordEscalation (escalation steps observable via ic route list) + RecordGate (gate_executed/gate_skipped, the reward-hacking control). Reuses the existing decision store per f-014 (no parallel evidence table). 3 observability tests pass; a skipped required gate is provably detectable. Commits a56acea + de38e7c. Verified zklw is UNREACHABLE from this session (SSH timeout, Tailscale auth gate) — so Phase 7 (real Hermes-on-zklw end-to-end) is a genuine hand-off, not deferrable by more coding. That is the ONLY remaining DoD gap.
